title: Understanding Kernel Functions
text: A kernel function is used in KDE to estimate the probability density function of a random variable. It has specific properties that make it suitable for this purpose.

title: Properties of Kernel Functions
text: Consider the properties of kernel functions: symmetry, non-negativity, and integration to a specific value. These are crucial for their role in KDE.
